official_records.page_consolidation_note: The page states: Texto actualizado con las modificaciones introducidas por el Dec-Ley 9504/80.
official_records.recorded_scope: The consolidated text describes the Pinamar unit created from General Madariaga and its boundary descriptions.
official_records.article_3_boundary_description: The municipality comprises lands then belonging to General Madariaga. Its north limit is the boundary with Municipio Urbano de la Costa; its east limit is the Atlantic coast from that boundary to the southern limit of Estancia Cariló; its south limit is the southern limit of those lands, according to a Dirección de Geodesia survey, from the Atlantic to Ruta Interbalnearia; its west limit is Ruta Interbalnearia and its alignment to the then-current General Lavalle boundary.

official_records.relevant_articles: Articles 2 and 4 amend Law 5827 on judicial organization. Article 4 states that no justice-of-the-peace court operates in Municipio Urbano de Pinamar and includes Pinamar within the territorial jurisdiction of the General Madariaga justice-of-the-peace court. Article 6 repeals Article 13 of Law 9024 and Article 11 of Law 9245.
official_records.boundary_effect: The act does not amend or repeal Article 3 or the Pinamar boundary description. Its absence would not materially prevent interpreting the consolidated Article 3 text for this cell; the missing geodesy survey is the material unresolved input.

result: The held center is inside the consumed simplified GeoBoundaries feature and outside both retained official IGN polygons. Decree-Law 9504/80 does not change Article 3's consolidated boundary description; however, that description makes the south limit depend on a Dirección de Geodesia survey that is not present or crosswalked here. The discrepancy is a substantiated source-relative unresolved candidate for review, not a positive or legal-boundary conclusion.
